ms.promise:
Objective:

Outputs:

ms.report:
We are submitting the Proof of Achievement (PoA) for Milestone 3: Review of Security Audit Findings, as part of Iagon’s ongoing commitment to audit readiness and continuous security enhancement.
The primary objective of this milestone was to conduct a thorough review of the security audit results, ensuring that all identified vulnerabilities are clearly documented, accurately prioritized, and internally validated for remediation.
Supporting Documentation:
・Findings Summary – A structured report outlining all identified issues from the security audit, including severity ratings and internal analysis notes - https://drive.google.com/file/d/12W_eXCIT44ewA4fGoT78jeuUzXSar-KI/view?usp=sharing ﻿
・Remediation Action Plan – A detailed plan describing how each finding will be addressed, including completed actions, ongoing efforts, and strategic decisions regarding deprecation, architectural improvements, or hardening measures - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JdsyQILWuzEPkcQnt076lv81n4nbYA4q/view?usp=sharing 

Acceptance Criteria Met:
・A comprehensive summary of vulnerabilities and associated risks has been delivered.
・A prioritized and actionable remediation plan has been finalized.
・The Iagon team has reviewed, acknowledged, and aligned internally on the findings and resolution roadmap.

This milestone reflects our commitment to transparency, best-practice security standards, and proactive risk management. We look forward to your review and are happy to provide any additional clarification as needed.

ms.promise:
Objective:
Conduct an architectural audit of Iagon’s core systems, evaluating vulnerabilities, infrastructure integrity, and overall design to provide a foundation for future improvements.
Outputs:
・Architectural Audit Report: Findings on architectural vulnerabilities and infrastructure risks. 
・Risk Assessment Documentation: Prioritized list of risks and vulnerabilities. 
・Recommendations for Mitigation: Suggested actions to address identified issues.
ms.criteria:
・Architectural audit completed with findings documented. 
・Risk assessment finalized and approved by Iagon team. 
・Recommendations for mitigation reviewed and validated by Iagon team.
ms.report:
We are submitting the Proof of Achievement (PoA) for Milestone 5: Architectural Audit, a critical step in our roadmap to enterprise readiness. This milestone focused on a comprehensive evaluation of Iagon’s core system architecture to identify structural vulnerabilities and ensure long-term infrastructure resilience.
Objective:
To conduct a full architectural audit of Iagon’s backend systems, assess infrastructure-level risks, and produce actionable recommendations that will guide improvements in system robustness, scalability, and security.
Supporting Documentation:
・Architectural Audit Report by MODUS (Redacted) – A summary of key findings from the audit, highlighting areas of architectural risk and design challenges. - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1c8jG7mdvLx-gV5hE_AHmu6PgI2IRAxik/view?usp=sharing 
・Risk Assessment Documentation – A prioritized list of identified vulnerabilities and risks is included as part of the Final Architectural Audit Report (Redacted) - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1c8jG7mdvLx-gV5hE_AHmu6PgI2IRAxik/view?usp=sharing 
・Recommendations for Mitigation – A detailed set of proposed solutions and actions to address the issues identified during the audit is included within the Final Architectural Audit Report (Redacted). This section outlines targeted remediation strategies and best-practice improvements for each risk category. - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1c8jG7mdvLx-gV5hE_AHmu6PgI2IRAxik/view?usp=sharing 

Acceptance Criteria Met:
・A full architectural audit has been completed with findings formally documented.
・The Iagon team has reviewed and approved the final risk assessment.

Recommendations for mitigation have been validated internally and will inform future development priorities.
